scope: Outcome-blind audit of a small official IDX stock-split announcement sample; event-document semantics only

document_evidence.semantics: stock-split plan; requests shareholder approval at RUPSLB scheduled for 16 April 2024
additional disclosure for a stock-split plan; again points to shareholder approval at RUPSLB on 16 April 2024
proof of advertisement of a stock-split implementation schedule; body records media publication on 17 May 2024
correction to a 20 May 2026 stock-split filing; body points to a detailed attachment and records the event date, but no effective market-transition date
advertised linked filing returned HTTP 403 and was not treated as a PDF or evidence

what_is_proven: Official announcement documents distinguish a plan, an approval process, an advertisement of a schedule, and a correction of an earlier filing.
A document's event date or advertisement date is not automatically an effective market-transition date.
A linked attachment can be unavailable even when the announcement metadata is present; the unavailable document cannot be reconstructed from the parent filing.
what_remains_unknown: RUPSLB approval and completion dates for the sampled plans
exchange trading adjustment/effective dates and the first session using the new share basis
knowledge-time and revision semantics for the event and attachment

admission.forbidden_use: infer effective price basis, repair historical prices, or admit a candidate from announcement dates
